description: OpenFlows Water is Bentley Systems' hydraulic modelling software for analysing and optimising water distribution networks, sold in tiers that bundle WaterCAD, WaterGEMS and HAMMER. It builds network models from GIS, CAD, database and SCADA data, calibrates them against measured flow and pressure, including AI-assisted optimisation, and runs hydraulic, water quality, transient, pump energy, fire flow and emergency, outage and pipe failure scenarios, with real-time SCADA integration for operational models and design optimisation of capital improvements under cost and hydraulic constraints. Coverage is any water distribution system; the tiers are limited to 100, 1,000 or 5,000 pipes, with an unlimited tier. Access is a paid 12-month subscription, from $1,021 for the smallest tier to $16,782 for the unlimited one as listed on the product page, with enterprise options. Caveats: proprietary software, and the pipe limits of the lower tiers restrict network size. Simulation uses: network flow, capacity planning, emergency and outage response and operational digital twins of water supply networks. Related records: OpenFlows Sewer (model-bentley-openflows-sewer), EPANET (model-epanet) and WNTR (model-wntr).
inputs: Water network data from GIS, CAD, databases and SCADA, and measured flow and pressure for calibration
